title: Spray Foam Storefront: Product Catalog and Order Placement

requirements.text: Create a public storefront that lets customers browse spray foam products, view product details, and add items to a cart.

quotes: creat a app that I can sell spray foam
I’ll build a simple storefront where customers can browse your spray foam products and place orders.

acceptanceCriteria: A customer can see a product listing page with product name, price, and image.
A customer can open a product detail view that shows full description and allows selecting quantity.
A customer can add/remove items from a cart and see subtotal updates client-side.

requirements.text: Implement checkout and order placement: collect customer contact and delivery information, show an order summary, and submit the order to the backend.

quotes: creat a app that I can sell spray foam

acceptanceCriteria: Checkout form includes at least: full name, email or phone, delivery address, and optional notes.
Order review shows line items (product, quantity, price) and total.
Submitting an order persists it in the backend and returns an order confirmation with an order ID.
Frontend displays success and error states for order submission.

requirements.text: Create backend data models and APIs to support: product catalog read access for customers and order creation/storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method to list products and a query method to fetch a single product by ID/slug.
Backend exposes an update method to create an order containing customer info, line items, totals, and timestamp.
Orders are stored durably in canister state and can be listed by an admin-only method (see REQ-4).

requirements.text: Add an owner/admin area protected by Internet Identity that allows managing products (create/edit/archive) and viewing incoming orders.

quotes: creat a app that I can sell spray foam

acceptanceCriteria: Admin login uses Internet Identity; unauthenticated users cannot access admin pages.
Admin can add a new product with: name, description, price, image URL/path, and active/inactive status.
Admin can edit existing products and deactivate (archive) products without deleting historical orders.
Admin can view a list of orders with basic customer info, totals, and status (e.g., New/Processing/Fulfilled/Cancelled).
Only the configured owner principal (or an allowlist) can call admin backend methods.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for an industrial building-materials storefront (no blue/purple palette): strong typography, high-contrast neutral palette, clear pricing/CTA hierarchy, and consistent spacing across pages.

quotes: creat a app that I can sell spray foam

acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across product listing, product detail, cart, checkout, and admin screens.
Primary and secondary buttons have clearly differentiated styles and consistent hover/focus states.
Layout is responsive (mobile and desktop) with readable typography and accessible contrast.

requirements.text: Add generated static brand assets and use them in the UI (hero/banner and a simple logo). Store generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

quotes: creat a app that I can sell spray foam

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
Storefront home/listing page displays the hero/banner image.
Header/nav displays the logo image.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.

Do not edit files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything under frontend/src/components/ui; compose around them instead.
No third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity for admin access.
No external databases or off-chain storage; persist products and orders in canister state.
nonGoals: Online payments integration (e.g., Stripe) and automated tax calculation.
Shipping rate calculation and carrier integrations.

required: Industrial spray foam storefront logo, bold sans-serif wordmark with a simple foam/insulation icon, black/charcoal on light background (spray-foam-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Wide hero banner featuring a clean industrial/warehouse aesthetic with spray foam/insulation texture motif, neutral grayscale with a warm accent (spray-foam-hero.dim_1600x600.png)
Product placeholder image with a minimal canister/tank silhouette and foam texture, neutral background (spray-foam-product-placeholder.dim_800x800.png)

goalsToAdd: Sell spray foam products online via a simple storefront with order placement.
